item.title: Apple didn't revolutionize power supplies; new transistors did (2012)
item.description:
📝 A switching power supply works on a very different principle: rapidly turning the power on and off, rather than turning excess power into heat. Switching power supplies are much more efficient, give off much less heat, and are much smaller and lighter than linear power supplies. General Electric published an early switching power supply design in 1959.
🔗 Read more: https://www.righto.com/2012/02/apple-didnt-revolutionize-power.html
